description.html: Arcadia EarthPro-A is the core supplement of the EarthPro line, made for all reptile and amphibian species. Instead of a lab-made mineral blend, it uses naturally mined mineral clay, together with calcium carbonate, vegetable protein powder with amino acids, carrot powder, algal carotenoids, a B-vitamin complex and bee pollen.

The manufacturer states that the powder contains no vitamin D3 and should be used with a suitable UVB system. Vitamin A is present as pro-vitamin A from carotenoids, which Arcadia says cannot be overdosed. The clay helps the powder stick to insects and plants, so less is wasted.

Under the EarthPro feeding programme, EarthPro-A is used at every feed and on all food items. Calcium with magnesium (CalciumPro-Mg) goes on every 4th feed, and a supplement with D3 and vitamin A at feed 6 or 8. Lightly coat insects with the powder in a bag, or sprinkle it over salad for herbivores.
Suitable for insectivores, herbivores and omnivores. See the full range of supplements in our equipment section.
